# Sightline Prompter

> A free, see-through desktop teleprompter for recording to camera (Windows,
> Mac, Linux). It's a fork of Electron Teleprompter by David Neal, adapted and
> enhanced by Joanne Lockwood from SEE Change Happen Ltd. It offers steady or
> voice-driven scrolling, script slots, and mirroring for beam-splitter rigs,
> plus an optional local API for AI assistants.

## Writing scripts for Sightline

The published pair is Sightline 1.1.0 and Stream Deck 0.2.0. Source documents
marked next preview include optional linked recording, explicit record commands,
production comments and saved Actual framing references. These are unpublished.
The user guide is the maintained documentation source; no separate wiki is enabled.

- [AI script brief](docs/AI-SCRIPT-BRIEF.md): instructions to paste into any script-writing AI
- [Script directives spec](docs/SCRIPT-DIRECTIVES.md): `{curly}` directives for the app, `[square]` notes for the speaker
- [Machine-readable directive definition](docs/script-directives.json)

## Controlling the app

- [README: AI and remote control](readme.md#change-log): the local HTTP API (off by default, token required) for opening or writing scripts, switching slots, playing, pausing and changing speed
